{{Quote|Commander, this is Lieutenant Tibbale, duty security officer. As per your standing order, I wished to inform you that Lord Odo's pilot has left his quarters and is currently in the bay officers' mess.|Lieutenant Tibbale, to Commander Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="Choices" />}}
'''Tibbale''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] as the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'''s]] duty [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date-COC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[third bridge officer]], set up a standing order to inform him whenever "[[Sorro]]," [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], left his [[Nuso Esva's quarters|quarters]] aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. Shortly after, Tibbale called Pellaeon via [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]], telling the commander that Sorro was on his way to the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers']] mess room; Pellaeon thanked him.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tibbale's voice appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
